# tx402 documentation

> tx402 is the spend-governance layer for x402 buyers: a non-custodial SDK (TypeScript + Python) that lets AI agents pay for HTTP 402-protected APIs safely — per-request caps, hourly budgets, and allowlists enforced *before* any key is signed, plus deterministic multi-chain routing (Base + Solana), RPC-endpoint failover, and typed, ambiguity-safe outcomes. Buyer-side only: it never custodies funds, calls a facilitator's verify/settle, or bridges/swaps. This site is the official documentation. A clean Markdown version of any page is available by appending `.md` to its path (e.g. `/guides/policy.md`).

## Start
- [Quickstart](https://docs.tx402.io/start/quickstart/): install and make a first paid call in minutes

## Guides
- [Payment lifecycle](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/lifecycle/): the 402 handshake — decode, policy, reserve, sign, retry, commit
- [Policy](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/policy/): spend caps, budgets, and allowlists enforced before signing
- [Routing](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/routing/): deterministic multi-chain routing and RPC-endpoint failover
- [CLI](https://docs.tx402.io/guides/cli/): the `tx402` command-line interface

## Reference
- [Configuration](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/configuration/): every client and policy option
- [Errors](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/errors/): the typed error taxonomy and exit codes
- [TypeScript API](https://docs.tx402.io/reference/api-typescript/): exported types and functions
